sources.supports: TCRA National Numbering and Signaling Point Codes Plans (July 2025) assigns mobile prefixes 068, 069, and 078 to Airtel Tanzania.
TCRA describes mobile-number portability, so a prefix does not prove which operator or wallet currently serves a number.

records.notes: Implemented in PR #58. Domestic ranges shown: 0680–0689, 0690–0699, 0780–0789. Prefixes appear in field help text as guidance only; validation accepts any structurally valid Tanzanian mobile number (+255 followed by 6 or 7 and eight digits) because of mobile-number portability.
